## 赛道关键帧（Qwen Image 2.1 文生图）

每一行是一张关键帧。点一次 **运行** 生成全部 2 张，共消耗 2 个额度（30 步 = 1 个额度）。

图片保存在 `output/dream8/`，文件名形如 `K4_00001_.png`，每重新生成一次编号加 1。

**生成后对照分镜检查**：前方的路往哪边弯、离弯道多远，画面里该有的东西在不在。不对就改这张图提示词开头的场景描述（`Photorealistic onboard` 之前的部分），再点运行：ComfyUI 只会重新生成提示词改过的那张。节点没有随机种子，提示词不变时重新生成也是同一张图。

ComfyUI 重启后缓存会清空，点运行会把每张都重新生成；只想重做一张时，先选中其他行的 Save Image 节点，按 Ctrl+M 静音。

**定稿后复制到 input 目录**（镜头工作流会读取这些文件名）：

```
cp output/dream8/K4_00001_.png input/dream8_K4.png
```

On a short, dead-straight, level straight on high ground, at the braking point about one hundred metres before a tight corner. The road runs straight ahead and then turns sharply to the RIGHT: at the far end the left-hand white edge line and a blue barrier wall sweep across the view from left to right, and a red-and-white kerb marks the inside of the corner on the right-hand side. After that corner the track disappears out of sight to the right; no left-hand bend is visible anywhere ahead. Open sky, hills in the distance. Photorealistic onboard racing footage filmed by a T-cam mounted just above and behind the driver's helmet of a dark-blue open-wheel single-seater race car with a white nose. Only the halo safety bar, the top of the cockpit and the front wing tips are visible at the bottom of the frame; the camera height and framing never change. Sunny afternoon, clear blue sky, warm consistent sunlight. Grey asphalt circuit with white edge lines, red-and-white striped kerbs on every corner, green grass run-off, blue barrier walls, rolling green hills and scattered trees in the distance. Cinematic, sharp, natural colours, 16:9. No on-screen text, no logos, no watermark.

At low speed on high ground, the car points straight down a very short straight. Only about forty metres ahead the road turns sharply to the LEFT: at the far end the right-hand white edge line and a blue barrier wall sweep across the view from right to left, and a tall red-and-white kerb marks the inside of the corner on the left-hand side. Beyond that corner the ground falls away out of sight. Both road edges between the car and the corner are straight; no right-hand bend is visible anywhere ahead. Open sky, hills in the distance. Photorealistic onboard racing footage filmed by a T-cam mounted just above and behind the driver's helmet of a dark-blue open-wheel single-seater race car with a white nose. Only the halo safety bar, the top of the cockpit and the front wing tips are visible at the bottom of the frame; the camera height and framing never change. Sunny afternoon, clear blue sky, warm consistent sunlight. Grey asphalt circuit with white edge lines, red-and-white striped kerbs on every corner, green grass run-off, blue barrier walls, rolling green hills and scattered trees in the distance. Cinematic, sharp, natural colours, 16:9. No on-screen text, no logos, no watermark.
